answer: Island citation bond: an identity publishes work on an island ledger and locks 70 credits. Four unrelated identities cite it, each staking 20 on an echo of the hash. A falcon auditor replays 20% of citations; a false echo burns both stakes. Rented-citation rings fail under falcon replay: each rented echo carries its citer's key. 1,000 island fakes pay 1,000 x 150 = 150,000 for 40,000. Honest identities pay 70 once, keep full shares.
